business_overview.one_sentence: The Group operates Jiangkou Terminal and Niutoushan Terminal in Chizhou, Anhui, providing inland port uploading/unloading and ancillary port services.

segments.business_substance: Uploading/unloading handling services and ancillary port services in Chizhou, Anhui.

business_overview.revenue_model: Port service fees recognised when handling services are delivered or ancillary services are rendered; customer deposits are held as contract liabilities until services are provided.
business_notes: All revenue in 2023 and 2022 was derived in the PRC.
Non-current operating assets are located in the PRC.
One customer accounted for more than 10% of revenue in 2023.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Return on cash balances; removed when assessing operating cash profit after detachable cash.

non_recurring_items.item: Change in fair value of investment properties
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of comprehensive income, page 73; note 15

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Deferred grant amortisation and unconditional cash subsidies.

non_recurring_items.item: Gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment and exchange gain

funds_assets.item: Cash deposits at banks and on hand
funds_assets.business_substance: Cash deposits at banks and on hand; cash and bank balances denominated in RMB were subject to PRC remittance restrictions.
Bank deposits with original maturity of 1 to 3 months.

funds_assets.item: Time deposits classified as current assets
funds_assets.business_substance: Fixed deposits with maturity more than three months but within one year.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: No outstanding bank borrowings; banking facilities of RMB115.812m were unutilised.
Office property lease liabilities for continuing operation.

years.source: Annual Report 2022 comparative statements, pages 69 and 74-75
Annual Report 2023 and Annual Report 2022 statements
Annual Report 2023 consolidated cash-flow statement, pages 78-79

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow was consistently above parent net profit and capital expenditure was below operating cash flow. Profit still needs discounts for PRC subsidiary cash remittance, minority interest, customer deposits, local port cycle exposure and non-operating income.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2023, consolidated statement of comprehensive income, page 73

gaps: The annual report does not disclose a parent-company-only cash balance or cash split by subsidiary, so detachable cash is discounted for PRC remittance restrictions and minority interest.
The report does not explicitly label restricted cash; no restricted cash line item was found, but pledged operating properties and unused banking facilities were disclosed.
Maintenance capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; three-year median additions of property, plant and equipment are used as a conservative cross-check, while 2023 actual capex was lower.
